text_block_list.text:
Recorded a "Bountiful Harvest." A marvelous result.
Thank you, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, the excess decorations can be stored
by putting them up in my room. There is no issue.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Upon visually registering these dolls, I caught a sensation that warmed the depths of my chest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words, it can be said that these have the effect of promoting mental stability.
